scope: Public web sources that originate, preserve, or contextualize David Choe archive records. This ledger stores metadata and links only, never copied site bodies or media.

sources.title: Dirty Hands: The Art and Crimes of David Choe
sources.relation: Feature documentary about David Choe. The archive holds a video-reviewed, 93-minute reading with 1,383 timestamped paragraphs, plus related trailers, a fragment, a San Francisco clip, and a deleted scene.
sources.coverage: Full archive reading and five related records.

sources.title: DavidChoe.com
sources.relation: David Choe's current official website and the canonical starting point for his biography, art, writing, and video pages.
sources.coverage: Site home and navigation indexed; source pages remain with their publisher.

sources.title: David Choe — Blog
sources.relation: The blog on David Choe's official domain. This is the verified current blog; no David Choe-authored Blogspot domain was verified.
sources.coverage: Blog index recorded without copying article bodies.

sources.title: David Choe — Work Index
sources.relation: The official chronological index of David Choe artwork and published projects.
sources.coverage: Index route recorded as a discovery source.

sources.title: David Choe — Videos
sources.relation: The official video directory, including a dedicated Dirty Hands page and other David Choe projects.
sources.coverage: Video index recorded; archive transcript coverage is listed separately.

sources.title: Dirty Hands — official David Choe page
sources.relation: David Choe's official page for the Dirty Hands documentary and trailer.
sources.coverage: Official film page tied to the full archive reading.

sources.title: David Choe — YouTube
sources.relation: The official David Choe YouTube channel. YouTube items represented in this archive retain their own source links and reader records.
sources.coverage: Channel identity indexed; individual archive coverage is searchable on the transcript home.

sources.title: David Choe — legacy Squarespace site
sources.relation: An older Squarespace-hosted version of David Choe's official site, including its own blog route.
sources.coverage: Legacy site identity and history links recorded.

sources.title: David Choe — legacy Squarespace blog
sources.relation: The blog route on the older Squarespace-hosted version of David Choe's official site.
sources.coverage: Legacy blog index and history links recorded without copying posts.

sources.title: DVDASA.com
sources.relation: The historical home of DVDASA, the podcast corpus at the center of this transcript archive.
sources.coverage: All 177 DVDASA episodes represented in the archive catalog.

sources.title: YumYumCha.com — Bill Poon
sources.relation: Bill Poon's historical blog. DVDASA conversations identify Poon as an early blogger and repeatedly name YumYumCha as his site.
sources.coverage: Identity tied to six timestamped archive episodes.

sources.title: The Poon Report — Bill Poon
sources.relation: Bill Poon's Tumblr companion to DVDASA, named directly in the show as poonreport.tumblr.com.
sources.coverage: Identity tied to four timestamped archive episodes.

sources.title: Koreans Gone Bad
sources.relation: A public archive of David Choe and Joe To's Koreans Gone Bad podcast, with contemporaneous Dirty Hands and Bill Poon references.
sources.coverage: Publisher archive indexed as historical context.

sources.title: Upper Playground — David Choe archive
sources.relation: Upper Playground's publisher archive of David Choe news, releases, exhibitions, and projects.
sources.coverage: Publisher index recorded without copying posts or images.

unverified.note: No primary or historical URL was verified. The current official blog and legacy Squarespace mirror are indexed instead of guessing a Blogspot address.
